method: Offline IDA headless analysis of existing local databases and source comparison; no device access.

clock_dxe.next_object_interpretation: DAL device identifier, not another EFI callback.
clock_dxe.installation_evidence: Installs the GUID at 0x16060 with the protocol pointer 0x16110.
clock_dxe.cluster_clock_initialization_evidence: Resolves apcs_cluster0_clk/apcs_cluster1_clk, selects chip revision-dependent clock data, and initializes NPA/AVS. This does not establish OSM or CPRh initialization.
clock_dxe.clock_mux_evidence: Updates clock mux source fields and update handshake. It is not an OSM initializer.
clock_dxe.conclusion: The newer header's CPU performance/frequency plan and PostInit slots must not be called through this binary's shorter 0x10005 protocol. Frequency query APIs cannot substitute for fuse calibration or OSM/CPRh hardware initialization.
clock_dxe.post_init_header_evidence: Header documentation describes flushing zero-bandwidth ICB nodes after UEFI bandwidth votes, not initializing OSM.

stock_firmware.limitation: These are hashes of local build inputs. They do not attest the firmware currently running on a device.

osm_v2_scope.tz_runtime_predicate: Before CPRh/OSM writes, both OSM banks must be disabled and the eight SCM-accessible v2 boot parameters (SEQ15/31/32/57/58/72/76/88) must match the selected stock TZ tables in both clusters. This is a compatible-state check, not a measurement of the running firmware.
osm_v2_scope.tz_predicate_provenance: Supersedes the earlier common/no-TZ v1 inference. Offline analysis of stock TZ.BF.4.0.6-00178 confirms v2 descriptor selection, raw parameter writes, and the SCM monitor allowlist; see osm-tz-initialization-audit.json and osm-tz-scm-audit.json.
osm_v2_scope.diagnostics: Failure records identify cluster, sequence register, expected and observed values. Stock TZ silently returns zero/discards writes outside its allowlist with success status, so transport and engine enforce the exact unconditional OSM subset. Protected microcode/PLL/PMIC registers are not probed.
initialization_order: Validate identity, retained clock configurations, both calibrated plans and the accessible v2 TZ boot parameters before CPRh/OSM writes.
Initialize and read back CPRh for both clusters.
Repeat OSM preflight, then program and read back both LUTs.
Apply core count and LLM policy, timers and FSM fields.
Apply the allowlisted MEM-ACC and APM SCM parameters with readback.
Initialize both ACD controllers with bounded transfer polling.
Select desired index zero for both clusters and enable OSM last.
osm_v2_scope.remaining_firmware_responsibility: Protected sequencer, CPU PLL/mux setup, PMIC transactions and TZ post-table initialization remain boot-chain prerequisites. The direct TZ caller discards initialization failure; matching the eight readable parameters proves only the table stage. A later marker at each bank +0x1050 is not read because HLOS access permission is unproven. See osm-tz-boot-chain-audit.json. No claim of complete TZ initialization or firmware attestation is made.
osm_v2_scope.validation: Host register-model test with compiler warnings treated as errors and address/undefined-behavior sanitizers. Covers the complete production calibration/CPRh/OSM/handoff/runtime path across 64 synthetic bin/revision/silicon combinations, including ownership transfer from a running unmatched CPR loop, bounded polling and injected failures. No claim of real-device validation.

handoff.publication: Version written last after all initialization/readback; kernel rejects v1 or incomplete checks.
handoff.flag_meaning: TZBootParameters and HLOSOwner; does not assert protected post-init completion or ownership of secure firmware resources.
